about: GitHub names of the Nest and Tiaris repositories. `current` is the name new records and URLs use; `names` lists every name that is the same repository. A rename or a move to another owner (CybexHQ to CybexBV, 2026-11-20) adds the new name to `names` and later moves `current` (only names GitHub ever used); a name is never removed, because signed, immutable releases keep the name they were published under. Read by tools/github_repositories.py (Python and workflow shell) and release/workstation-netboot.nix.
